issues.description: Element: public instance method on class de.tum.cit.ase.Farm. Problem statement and template require a public method named singFarmSong() (used to play the Old MacDonald song). The template provides a singFarmSong() stub in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, and the example Main calls farm.singFarmSong(). The solution implementation exposes the same functionality under a differently named public method playFarmSong() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java). This naming mismatch between the expected API (singFarmSong) and the solution implementation (playFarmSong) will confuse students mapping requirements to the reference code and can break any code/tests that call singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's public API match the problem statement and template. Either rename the solution method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() method in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Update any references accordingly so code and tests expecting singFarmSong() compile and run without modification.
